messages.subject: why models in rattle (except the default rpart) are inactive after loading a file?
parts:
Dear Rattle users,
I am using Rattle  Version 3.0.2  under R version 3.0.2 in windows 7. Whenever, I upload a file (*.csv), the model tab becomes inactive and the result gives only rpart. In fact I need to do svm classification and regression. Is there any thing that I missed it? Moreover, frequently it requests runtime to quit randomly, seems it uses high cpu and memmory?

Thanks!
